title: N6(2+) and N4(2+) Dications and Their N12 and N10 Azido Derivatives: DFT/GIAO-MP2 Theoretical Studies
authors: Olah G.A., Prakash G.K.S., Rasul G.
notes_general: Main subject (N6^2+ structures 1-4, N4^2+ structure 5) is OUT OF SCOPE: charge +2, outside the neutral/+1/-1 pool. Only the azide-adduct products (structures 6-10, from reacting the dications with N3- ions) are in-scope N-only neutral/+1 species. The paper explicitly states 'Calculated structures of 6-10 agree well with those reported[refs 7,8]' where ref 7=Bartlett unpublished polynitrogen report (not in this archive) and ref 8=Glukhovtsev et al. (poly-N.pdf, ALREADY in existing corpus) -- strongly suggesting N12(9,C2h) and possibly N10(7,D2d) duplicate existing corpus topologies. Figure 3 shows bond-length-labeled 2D diagrams for structures 6-10 but WITHOUT atom-index numbering, so precise per-bond transcription was not attempted (topology/point-group/shape only). Full Cartesian coordinates exist in the paper's Supporting Information (referenced in text) but that SI file is not part of this archive.
